label: Lyrebird Arch
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One independent square Glaze artwork with true transparent background. RASPNEST HEATH, a tangible heathland formed entirely from dry EXCELSIOR WOOD-WOOL sculpture. The reference is our own echidna artwork and is used ONLY to match physical material and lighting; create a wholly different subject. Many irregular thin FLAT brittle wood shavings, tangled ribbons and pointed splinters with longitudinal grain, fibrous fractured tips, subtle curved edges, open inter-strand gaps and compressed dense anatomical bundles. Natural pale honey, russet bark and smoky brown woods, matte and dry, diffuse studio macro lighting, convincing material depth. No smooth solid wooden core, polished carving, fur/plush, string/thread, woven fabric, wire, clay, paper quilling, rolled rosettes or concentric coils. Entire subject fits into central 70% with ample truly transparent space on every side; all tips, claws and foliage comfortably inside the image. No floor or shadow outside subject, panel, backing, atmosphere, frame, text, symbols, clock/battery/calendar or UI. Strong singular silhouette readable at85px. SUBJECT: a complete LYREBIRD standing on two delicate strongly articulated clawed feet in profile toward right, with a small plain head and short beak, compact layered wing, and extraordinary raised LYRE-SHAPED tail. Two broad long curved outer tail feathers arch above the whole body and enclose a fan of fine loose straight splinter strands; these are raw wooded feathers, not quilled coils. One clear arch-shaped tail and bird silhouette. Keep both feet, all tail tips and beak comfortably whole. No echidna or lizard.
processing: Whole original uniformly contained within900px on transparent1024square, alpha preserved. No subject crop, recolour or artistic edits.

references.purpose: Own first artwork supplies the physical wood-shaving material and lighting only; new distinct subject.
